title: Abbreviated ADU Submittal Packet
disclaimer: ClearPath hackathon sample. Not an official City of Irvine document and not for submittal. Abbreviated from public City of Irvine and OCFA forms for software testing; field sets are condensed and staff-only content is simplified.
